name: humanize-writing
description: Remove signs of AI-generated writing from text. Use when the user mentions 'sounds like AI,' 'too robotic,' 'humanize this,' 'make it sound human,' 'de-AI this,' 'sounds like ChatGPT,' 'make it natural,' or 'doesn't sound like a person wrote it.' Detects and fixes AI writing patterns including inflated significance, promotional language, formulaic structure, AI vocabulary, superficial analyses, vague attributions, hedging, robotic rhythm, em dash and boldface overuse, chatbot artifacts, and missing personality. Based on Wikipedia's "Signs of AI writing" guide and editorial best practices.
author: jpeggdev
